_source: Our own table (docs/eras/luv.md "Stations", decisions 3 and 17; package LuV-B1).
_how_it_is_used: The station pieces of LuV wait for spike S0-3 (a station packed, launched and used in Earth orbit, then a second one in a moon's orbit). Until it passes natively, enabled stays false: the keycard stays hidden (tools/analysis/tiers/obtain.json, era 'LuV (orbital station)'), no EMI page explains the packager, and gg_test_luv_b1's station stage is skipped, not failed.

GCYR's own pieces need no recipe of ours: the station packager (gcyr:shaped/space_station_packager, a LuV hull) and the package (gcyr:assembler/space_station_package) keep GCYR's recipes; the keycard is the packager's output; the ID chip is grindless:gcyr/id_chip.

When S0-3 passes: set enabled to true, delete gcyr:keycard from the 'LuV (orbital station)' rule and its group in hidden_until.json, add the packager/keycard EMI info page and run node tools/analysis/emi-coverage.mjs --expect. If the second station fails, second becomes null and B7 builds the Io sulfur-iodine plant (decision 17).

The Io-orbit slot (package B7) follows this table alone (startup_scripts/grindless/lib/stations.js, G.stations.b7): second null -> 'sulfur_iodine' (the Io sulfur-iodine plant; also when no station passes); enabled true with second = grindless:io_orbit -> 'tether' (the flux-tube tether); otherwise 'pending' (neither is registered). The active machine's registration, recipes and controller recipe (luv/io_orbit.js), the tether spool's hiding (hidden_until.json's unless 'tether') and the quests' S03/B7T/B7S packages (tools/quests/luv-stations.mjs) switch with it. After flipping: regenerate the quest chapters (docs/quests.md), run node tools/analysis/emi-coverage.mjs --expect and the Node suite, and refresh the pack index.
